## Why This Is Asked
Tests handling of Kleene three-valued constraints with backtracking and propagation across multiple clauses.

## Key Concepts
- Kleene 3-valued semantics with T>U>F
- Implication as ¬A ∨ B and its evaluation with U
- Backtracking propagation in constraint satisfaction

## Code Example
```javascript
// Kleene not and or (simplified semantics)
function not(v){ return v==='T'?'F': v==='F'?'T':'U'; }
function or(a,b){ const order=['F','U','T']; return (order.indexOf(a) > order.indexOf(b)) ? a : b; }
function implies(a,b){ return or(not(a), b); }
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you extend to N variables with a clause-loss heuristic?
- How does the search tree change with additional U-valued clauses?
